downloads.note: Each unified zip bundles all five plugins for that platform; the 'releases/latest/download' URLs always resolve to the newest tagged release. For the CLIProxyAPI plugin store (install/update per plugin from the management panel) each release additionally carries per-plugin zips named '{plugin_id}_{version}_{goos}_{goarch}.zip' plus a checksums.txt — the store resolves them from each plugin's repository field automatically. The split package carries the legacy per-variant plugin ids (codebuddy-cn, trae-solo-cn, ...) — install it INSTEAD OF, not next to, the unified plugin of the same provider.

plugins.name: CodeBuddy
plugins.description: Tencent CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy unified provider for CPA (merged v0.9.0 + v0.11.0): one credit pool, three realms (copilot.tencent.com CN, workbuddy.ai Global, codebuddy.ai Intl), dual login platforms (CLI + CodeBuddy IDE), auto-adopts legacy codebuddy-cn / codebuddy-intl auth files, OpenAI-compatible chat, daily check-in, credit lifecycle, multi-account pool.
plugins.author: mmqz
plugins.changelog: A 401 storm now surfaces the session-dead re-login guidance on EVERY caller, not just the renewal's owner (joiners of the in-flight renewal and callers throttled inside the 30s window inherit the verdict; 0.9.77's heal, renew-once/resend-once, and all earlier behavior unchanged). Caught by the new concurrent storm tests over a live fake upstream.

plugins.name: Qoder
plugins.description: Qoder unified provider for CPA (merged v0.10.0): CN (qoder.com.cn) and Intl (qoder.com / openapi.qoder.sh) in one plugin, per-account region routing, device-flow + PAT login, COSY-signed chat, daily check-in with streak, Pro upgrade claim, token keepalive, auto-adopts legacy qoder-cn / qoder-intl auth files.
plugins.author: mmqz
plugins.changelog: A queue ticket that reports queueCount=0 (nobody ahead) no longer sleeps its 30s estimate three times: it retries on a 700ms ladder, one credential per 12s window runs that ladder (credential rotation no longer pays for it repeatedly), and the pair then cools for a single window instead of a minute. Tickets with a real depth keep the v0.8.64 wait unchanged.

plugins.name: Trae
plugins.description: Trae unified provider for CPA (merged v0.12.0): Trae Code CN (api.trae.cn inline_chat), Trae SOLO CN (solo_work_lite) and Trae Intl (api.marscode.com Web SOLO) in one plugin, per-variant routing, real-time SSE, daily check-in, auto-adopts legacy trae-cn / trae-solo-cn / trae-intl auth files.
plugins.author: mmqz
plugins.changelog: One sign-in device for the whole login (#47): the URL, ExchangeToken, credential and bound refresh all carry the same device — the callback no longer swaps to the per-account derived identity (fixes 401 20403 on every fresh CN/intl login).

plugins.name: ZCode
plugins.description: ZCode unified provider for CPA (GLM coding plan): Z.AI (api.z.ai) and BigModel (open.bigmodel.cn) in one plugin, server-mediated CLI login via zcode.z.ai (no local callback), per-account provider routing, permanent API keys + plan JWT, Client Request Signing V4 (Ed25519 + PoW, fail-open retry ladder), pinned glm-4.5-air..glm-5.3-flash catalog, billing/balance quota panel, per-model cooldown, auto-adopts legacy zcode.json files.
plugins.author: mmqz
plugins.changelog: Empty first-user messages (content missing/null/""/whitespace-only/empty array) no longer collide every conversation's x-session-id into one constant UUID — they take the per-device fallback, so distinct conversations and accounts stay distinct for BigModel's prompt cache. 0.2.6's stability contracts unchanged and now pinned.

plugins.name: MiMo
plugins.description: Xiaomi MiMo provider for CPA: platform OAuth lane with desktop session adoption as a secondary lane, serving the MiMo chat model family through the OpenAI-compatible surface.
plugins.author: mmqz
plugins.changelog: Paste lanes submit via in-page fetch — no more dead-page navigation after pasting a lane URL.
